stories.author: Carlo De Marchis
stories.title: October's best golfer had never won in 99 PGA Tour starts
stories.dek: Austin Smotherman, 32, won his 100th at Black Desert on 4 October, 26 under and two clear. Three weeks later in Bermuda the wind cancelled the final round and he beat Seamus Power with a par on the third playoff hole. Two wins in a month, and a place at Pebble Beach next June.
